patch_description: Crossover combining the current program's temperature-annealed soft-min/soft-max L-BFGS optimization (which reaches ~0.99) with the prior program's structured starts (icosahedron+poles, Fibonacci sphere, cube+face-centers, jittered variants) and its exact SLSQP epigraph polish (maximize t s.t. t^2 <= ||pi-pj||^2 <= 1). Pipeline: structured + random starts → soft-annealed L-BFGS → exact-ratio L-BFGS polish → SLSQP epigraph polish on the best candidates with small random restarts. Final result is centered and scaled so dmax=1.
